parsed.rationale: This is a regular sinus rhythm at about 75 bpm with narrow QRS complexes, upright T waves and ST segments at baseline in every lead, so there is no significant ST elevation, no reciprocal ST depression and no pathological Q waves, and the tracing does not support acute STEMI.
